decisions.title: Old Albuquerque High School Metropolitan Redevelopment Plan
decisions.description: Documents the redevelopment framework for the former Albuquerque High School property, coordinating historic preservation, renovation, public improvements, private investment, and reuse of a prominent Huning Highland landmark.

decisions.title: Central/Highland/Upper Nob Hill Metropolitan Redevelopment Plan
decisions.description: Guides reinvestment along Central Avenue through business revitalization, housing, higher-density mixed use, pedestrian improvements, neighborhood stabilization, and coordinated public and private development in the Near Heights.

decisions.title: Clayton Heights Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Plan
decisions.description: Establishes a redevelopment strategy for the Clayton Heights gateway neighborhood, addressing land use, housing, infrastructure, streets, economic conditions, opportunity sites, community priorities, and implementation tools.

decisions.title: Coronado Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Plan
decisions.description: Plans environmental remediation, public-right-of-way improvements, and mixed-use redevelopment of the former industrial property, supporting new housing, jobs, retail, entertainment, connectivity, safety, drainage, and a northern gateway identity.

decisions.title: Del Rey Metropolitan Redevelopment Project Plan
decisions.description: Records the negotiated redevelopment plan for the Del Rey area, including project boundaries, housing and land-development conditions, resident coordination, public actions, statutory findings, and implementation responsibilities.

decisions.title: South Broadway Neighborhoods Metropolitan Redevelopment Plan
decisions.description: Preserves the long-running South Broadway redevelopment framework, including neighborhood conditions, housing, commercial corridors, industry, community facilities, transportation, historic character, public improvements, adopted amendments, and implementation history.

decisions.title: South Barelas Industrial Park Metropolitan Redevelopment Plan
decisions.description: Promotes environmentally compatible industrial growth beside Barelas, covering business expansion, vacant-land development, City property disposition, industrial-park image, local hiring, code enforcement, transportation access, and infrastructure improvements.

decisions.title: St. Joseph Hospital Metropolitan Redevelopment Plan
decisions.description: Preserves the redevelopment record for the former St. Joseph Hospital and Civic Auditorium area, including renovation projects, later development areas, amendments, and the 2017 transition from sector plan to retained MRA plan.

decisions.title: Tingley Beach Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Project I Plan
decisions.description: Preserves the 1983 Project I redevelopment plan for the beach property at West Central Avenue and the Rio Grande, documenting the statutory framework, site conditions, public actions, and proposed reuse.

decisions.title: West Central Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Plan
decisions.description: Guides revitalization along West Central through economic development, streetscape and appearance improvements, opportunity-site design, industrial employment, neighborhood retail, mixed-use development, housing, and connections to the Rio Grande Bosque.

decisions.title: Southwest Area Plan
decisions.description: Preserves the jointly adopted Southwest Area Plan covering growth, land use, transportation, infrastructure, community form, environmental resources, public facilities, economic development, implementation, and City and County responsibilities.

decisions.title: Volcano Trails Sector Development Plan
decisions.description: Preserves the adopted Volcano Trails framework for village-center and residential development, open space, transportation, trails, infrastructure, urban design, zoning, implementation, and protection of the volcanic landscape.

decisions.title: Volcano Trails Sector Development Plan Adoption Resolution R-11-211
decisions.description: Records City Council’s adoption and zoning actions for the 446-acre Volcano Trails plan area, including village center, residential districts, open space, boundaries, findings, and implementation conditions.

decisions.title: Fourth Street and Montaño Community Visioning Report
decisions.description: Documents community priorities for the Fourth Street and Montaño area, including traffic, pedestrian safety, drainage, neighborhood character, commercial development, public space, land use, and coordinated improvement strategies.

decisions.title: ABQ BioPark Master Plan
decisions.description: Sets a comprehensive vision for the Zoo, Aquarium, Botanic Garden, and Tingley Beach, covering visitor experience, animals, circulation, parking, utilities, sustainability, operations, capacity, facilities, and phased capital improvements.
decisions.large_file_assessment: This graphics-heavy 116-page comprehensive facilities plan contains detailed illustrations, maps, and concepts. No smaller authoritative City version was located. Optimization would alter the preserved source, so the original is retained without modification.

decisions.title: Tijeras Arroyo Biological Zone Open Space Resource Management Plan
decisions.description: Provides the detailed management framework for Tijeras Arroyo Open Space and adjacent lands, addressing natural and cultural resources, recreation, trails, education, restoration, access, partnerships, priorities, and implementation.

decisions.title: Tijeras Bio-Zone Education Center Proposed Site Plan Presentation
decisions.description: Presents the proposed education center’s goals, program, partners, public input, building evolution, and site concept emphasizing accessibility, environmental protection, community science, outdoor learning, and Tijeras Cultural Corridor connections.

decisions.title: Paseo de la Mesa Recreation Trail Map
decisions.description: Maps the Paseo de la Mesa Recreation Trail, parking, adjoining Major Public Open Space and Petroglyph National Monument lands, nearby volcanic features, streets, and connections across Albuquerque’s Northwest Mesa.

decisions.title: Sandia Foothills Open Space Trail Map
decisions.description: Maps the Sandia Foothills trail network, trailheads, numbered routes, Elena Gallegos, Embudito, Bear Canyon, access streets, and the Wilderness boundary, preserving a dated field reference for historical comparison.

decisions.title: City of Albuquerque Open Space Overview Map
decisions.description: Provides a systemwide reference to City Open Space properties and nearby tribal, federal, county, and municipal lands, with numbered sites spanning the Bosque, foothills, volcanic mesa, and East Mountain areas.

decisions.title: Albuquerque Bird Watching Guide and Map
decisions.description: Maps birding locations across Albuquerque and pairs them with habitat and species guidance, connecting residents to the Bosque, wetlands, foothills, parks, Open Space lands, and accessible urban wildlife-viewing sites.

decisions.title: City of Albuquerque Climate Action Plan
decisions.description: Preserves Albuquerque’s first Climate Action Task Force recommendations, covering greenhouse-gas accounting, buildings, renewable energy, neighborhoods, food, waste, behavior change, and transportation before the City’s later equity-centered plan.

decisions.title: Albuquerque Climate Action Plan
decisions.description: Sets Albuquerque’s community-scale climate strategy with equity-centered actions for governance, energy, buildings, transportation, waste, economic development, adaptation, health, and accountability, informed by frontline-community engagement and implementation priorities.

decisions.title: Central New Mexico Community-Scale Greenhouse Gas Inventory
decisions.description: Quantifies 2023 community greenhouse-gas emissions across Central New Mexico, documenting methods, energy, transportation, waste, industrial sources, agriculture, land use, and the baseline used for regional climate planning and progress measurement.

decisions.title: AHYMO-S4-R2 Hydrologic Model User’s Manual
decisions.description: Documents Albuquerque’s official arid-lands hydrologic modeling software, including watershed inputs, rainfall, infiltration, routing, detention facilities, sediment, output interpretation, examples, and procedures used in local drainage analysis and development review.

decisions.title: City of Albuquerque Construction Site Manual
decisions.description: Sets illustrated inspection standards for construction-site sediment and erosion controls, vehicle tracking, inlet protection, channels, housekeeping, washout, debris, street cuts, curb work, stabilization, and maintenance of required best practices.

decisions.title: AMAFCA/Albuquerque MS4 Floatable and Gross Pollutant Study
decisions.description: Analyzes litter and gross pollutants entering Albuquerque’s municipal stormwater system, identifies sources and drainage conditions, evaluates reduction strategies and structural controls, and establishes a coordinated AMAFCA-City program framework.

decisions.title: Replanning the Modern City for Transit
decisions.description: Records the Planning Department’s briefing to the 21st Century Transportation Task Force on comprehensive planning, growth, centers and corridors, land-use change, transit-supportive development, public investment, and coordinated implementation.

decisions.title: Planned Growth Strategy Briefing
decisions.description: Preserves the task force’s concise policy record on Albuquerque’s Planned Growth Strategy, linking the Comprehensive Plan with urban growth management, infrastructure, regulations, public input, and future implementing legislation.

decisions.title: ABQ RIDE Planning Briefing
decisions.description: Documents ABQ RIDE’s 2008 planning organization, inputs, route and schedule development, shelters, park-and-ride, transit-oriented development, active projects, department plans, national trends, and anticipated service priorities.

decisions.title: 2040 Long-Range Roadway Map
decisions.description: Preserves the City’s 2040 roadway planning map for Albuquerque and the broader metropolitan area, showing long-range functional classifications and planned network connections for historical comparison with current regional system maps.

decisions.title: 2015 Bikeways and Trails Facilities Plan Appendix A: Proposed Facilities
decisions.description: Preserves the 2015 plan’s detailed proposed-facilities tables, listing bikeways and trails by facility type, street or route, endpoints, priority category, length, and project status for historical network comparison.

decisions.title: Neighborhood Traffic Management Program Policy Manual
decisions.description: Defines Albuquerque’s Neighborhood Traffic Management Program goals, eligibility, request and evaluation process, prioritization, neighborhood participation, funding, implementation, and traffic-calming strategies for local and collector streets.

decisions.title: Streets and Traffic Enhancement Program Draft Policy Manual and Resolution
decisions.description: Preserves the original STEP proposal and draft resolution that preceded the 2015 NTMP policy, documenting proposed administrative rules, traffic-calming tools, evaluation, neighborhood participation, funding, and legislative lineage.
